nodes.label: Project Changelog
nodes.description: Keep a Changelog format. v0.1.0 (2026-09-09): initial v2 release with transactional outbox, Redis Streams, Vue 3 SPA, Laravel 12 backend, Python ingestion, Docker Compose (8 services). Unreleased: durable publication pipeline (outboxes + Debezium + CDC streams + consumers), public minimal API for graph and restricted sensor series, private channels for alerts and device status, BackendClient exponential backoff, MonitorCard/SensorMonitorBoard ownership split, MigrationIntegrityTest.
nodes.rationale: Tracks the project's evolution from v0.1.0 through the current refraccion branch. Documents the transition from legacy relay to Debezium CDC and the addition of private broadcasting channels.
